resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or equivalent open-source planewave DFT code)

access.notes: Any planewave DFT code with PAW or norm-conserving pseudopotentials and van der Waals correction capability.
Standard PAW pseudopotentials for Y, N, S, H, O. Equivalent libraries (e.g., PseudoDojo) are acceptable.
Optional – simplifies structure building and job management.
